description: Returns the catalog of VIDEO models to choose from: id, name, what it's best at, durations (seconds), resolutions, aspect ratios, and an indicative price in credits (for the default duration; longer clips cost more). Call this BEFORE generate_video when the user wants to pick a specific video model or compare options/prices.

project_dir.description: Absolute path of the project (default: current directory).

name: list_video_models
title: List the video models the user can pick
